text:
maria: quick flag - encountered a parity/regression between our Python SDK and the new Rust sample app when calling embeddings + rerank. Python returns 2048-d vectors, Rust returns 1536 for the same model string and input. Also rerank order differs.

devon: same model string exactly?

maria: yes `redwood-embed-xl` in both. No batching helpers involved, single input. Printed shapes immediately after SDK call.

paul: can you paste raw response body and relevant headers (especially x-request-id and any x-rw-* headers)?

maria: pasted below. Python response (sanitized) shows `embedding` array of 2048 floats. Rust shows 1536. Rust raw headers included `x-request-id: req_rs_0a1b2c` and response body had `model_variant: compact-1` in debug meta.

igor: hmm we had a routing fallback that serves a compact embedding variant (1536) when a primary pool is saturated. That should only happen server-side and be surfaced in headers. Did the client retry the request? If a retry loses the model pin header, the retried request may land on a different pool.

maria: good call. The Rust SDK has a retry middleware that clones the request but I realized it doesn't copy custom headers we set (e.g., `x-rw-model-version` or `x-rw-embed-format`). Python preserves them.

devon: that explains dims. What about rerank ordering?

maria: Rust sample unpacked scores into a HashMap<id, score> and then iterated with `into_iter()` to build final list, which can change iteration order. Python preserves server order in list. Result: same scores but different item order.

paul: two actionable fixes: 1) ensure retry clones all headers including custom x-rw-* headers; 2) change sample app to preserve server ordering (use Vec or preserve index).

igor: agreed. I'll put a patch up to fix header cloning in the retry layer. Also add a test that compares embedding dims between Python and Rust for a canonical input and asserts `X-Model-Variant` header consistency.

maria: repro snippets:

Python:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(input="...", model="redwood-embed-xl")
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))  # 2048
```

Rust snippet:
```
let resp = client.embeddings().create(&request).await?;
println!("len={}", resp.data[0].embedding.len()); // 1536
```

And note: when Rust retried on 429 it did not include our `x-rw-model-version` header on the retry.

lydia: marking this P0 for the next patch. Customers using different SDKs could silently get vector dim mismatches.

paul: sdk-ci-bot created ticket RW-ENG-SDK-1287 and assigned to @igor. Link: https://rw.internal/issue/RW-ENG-SDK-1287

igor: I'll also change the sample app docs: recommend pinning model via header and avoid HashMap for ordered rerank responses.

maria: applied local fix: modified retry middleware to clone headers + changed HashMap->Vec for rerank assembly. Re-tested: both SDKs now output 2048 and rerank order matches. New request ids `req_rs_fix001` and `req_py_fix002`.

devon: nice! please add a short note in the devex guide and the sample app README about stable ordering and header retention during retries.

maria: will do. thanks all for the quick triage. :rocket:
